info.title: hydromart-digital WhatsApp STOP list (number 1 <-> number 2)
info.description:
HD-12/HD-13. WhatsApp number 1 (transaction notifications) lives in hydromart-digital; number 2 (customer service) lives in the AI web. A customer who sends STOP to either must be silent on both, so the two sides keep one STOP list between them. This file is the contract of that sync: the AI web PULLS number 1's rows and PUSHES its own.

Authentication: a machine token (aud hydromart-machine, ES256) from POST /auth/api/v1/auth/machine/token (auth.openapi.json) whose scopes include waOptOutSync. The AI web's machine account holds it. An ES256 token of any other kind (aud hydromart-ai) and a machine token without the scope are refused with 403. Every POST is recorded in the audit trail BEFORE it runs and refused with 503 when it cannot be recorded; nothing is written then.

While WhatsApp is switched off on the hydromart-digital side these routes still answer (the ledger is data), and the AI web may keep polling.

PULLER CONTRACT (read this before writing the poller). `seq` is a database sequence and is NOT commit-ordered: a row with a lower seq can become visible after a row with a higher one was already read, so a puller that trusts its cursor alone can skip a STOP. Therefore: on every poll ask for `after = cursor - 1000` (an overlap window, never below 0), and dedupe what comes back on `id`, which is stable. Move the cursor to `nextAfter` only after every item of the page is stored. Poll every 30-60 seconds; each successful GET also stamps a clock hydromart-digital reads: if the AI web has not called for longer than 180 seconds, hydromart-digital treats the AI web's STOP list as unknown and holds every marketing message (never sends on hope).

One person, one list: the newest choice across both numbers wins for MARKETING; a STOP on number 1 also ends utility messages on number 1 only.

Compatibility: unknown request fields are refused (400). A field may be added to a response within version 1; removing or renaming one is a new contract version.

get.summary: Pull the consent rows number 1 wrote (STOP, MULAI, PROMO, opt-in) after a cursor.
get.description: Rows whose source is not AIWEB, oldest seq first, at most `limit` (default and maximum 500). Phones are digits only, 62..., no plus. `purpose` is UTILITY or MARKETING; `granted` false is a STOP, true is an opt-in or MULAI/PROMO. `nextAfter` is the largest seq in the page (the `after` you sent when the page is empty). See the puller contract above: re-read an overlap window and dedupe on `id`.

400.description: VALIDATION_ERROR: after or limit is not a whole number in range.

401.description: UNAUTHORIZED: no token, an expired one, or one that is not a machine token.

403.description: FORBIDDEN: a valid token whose scopes do not include waOptOutSync, or an AI-web token.

post.summary: Push the AI web's own number-2 STOP or MULAI (MARKETING only).
post.description: Call it at the moment the customer sends STOP or MULAI on number 2, then again from a retry sweep until it answers 200. Idempotent on `eventId` (use `wa2:<seq>`): a replay answers 200 with the item counted under `duplicates`. `recordedAt` is the moment the customer acted; it orders their choices across both numbers and is never taken from the future. The batch is all or nothing: a phone that is not an Indonesian mobile number refuses the whole call with 400 and writes nothing.

400.description: VALIDATION_ERROR: a field is wrong, an unknown field was sent, or a phone is not an Indonesian mobile number.

401.description: UNAUTHORIZED: no token, an expired one, or one that is not a machine token.

403.description: FORBIDDEN: a valid token whose scopes do not include waOptOutSync, or an AI-web token.

503.description: SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE: the call could not be recorded in the audit trail; nothing was written. Retry the same body.

machineToken.description: Authorization: Bearer <accessToken> from POST /auth/api/v1/auth/machine/token. ES256, aud hydromart-machine; its scopes claim is the machine account's closed capability list.

id.description: Stable id of the row: the AI web dedupes on it.

seq.description: Order of insertion; not commit-ordered (see the puller contract).

phone.description: Any spelling of an Indonesian mobile number (0812..., +62812..., 62812...).

code.description: VALIDATION_ERROR, UNAUTHORIZED, FORBIDDEN, RATE_LIMITED or SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE.

message.description: For people reading logs. Route on statusCode and code.
